originality.rationale: Focused claim, alias, practical-number, almost-practical, and exact-count searches found the classical coverage criterion and neighboring subset-sum results but no equivalent or dominating complete-or-injective theorem. The full text of the modern open restatement was inspected. Stewart (1954) was bibliographically identified but its full text was inaccessible, leaving a stated residual historical-overlap risk.
residual_risks: The full text of Stewart (1954) was not accessible, so a historically equivalent observation hidden in that paper cannot be completely excluded.

value.rationale: The theorem identifies a sharp structural transition exactly at the classical practical threshold: full interval coverage on one side and global collision-freeness on the other. The exact image and deficit formulas add motivated information not contained in practical-number membership alone, including a quantitative exclusion of near-complete coverage for this family.
